title: Temporal circulation of heart rate and short-window variability: an exploratory cross-database heart-failure prediction test
abstract: Adding signed five-minute rate–variability circulation changed external CHF-versus-normal Brier loss by +0.00617 (joint record bootstrap 95% [-0.00377, 0.02006]) beyond conventional HRV, Porta/Guzik asymmetry, marginal dispersion and instantaneous coupling. The registered incremental-benefit criterion was not met.
